name: expert-panel
description: 专家团共识评审：多位不同视角专家独立作答→真匿名互评→仲裁归纳（共识率脚本计算、不足自动加辩）→主席综合→事实复核；quick/standard/deep 三档，零配置，结论按一致/分歧分离绝不硬合成。

description_i18n.en: Expert-panel consensus review: independent answers from multiple expert lenses → truly anonymous cross-critique → arbitration (consensus rate computed by script, extra debate round below threshold) → chair synthesis → fact verification; quick/standard/deep profiles, zero config, conclusions separate agreed items from explicit disagreements.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 专家团共识评审：多位不同视角专家独立作答→真匿名互评→仲裁归纳（共识率脚本计算、不足自动加辩）→主席综合→事实复核；quick/standard/deep 三档，零配置，结论按一致/分歧分离绝不硬合成。
